title: Social Comparison and Young Adult Mental Health with Endogenous Network Formation
title_zh: 内生网络形成下的社会比较与青年心理健康研究
title_primary: 内生网络形成下的社会比较与青年心理健康研究
title_secondary: Social Comparison and Young Adult Mental Health with Endogenous Network Formation
authors: Junwei Fan, Santiago Montoya-Blandon, Eugenio Proto
official: 官方在线 2026-09-08 · 来源：出版社网页
abstract: We examine how social comparison within endogenously formed peer networks affects different measures of young adult mental health. Using over 2 million smartphone-based communication records from the NetHealth Study, we construct objective social networks among university students and estimate a structural model in which individuals choose their peers and mental health depends on the income of chosen peers. When networks are treated as exogenous, higher average peer income predicts better mental health; once network formation is modelled endogenously, the relationship reverses: exposure to higher-income peers significantly worsens depressive symptoms. Income gaps harm mental health in both directions, consistent with inequality aversion rather than relative deprivation. The reversal survives extending binary links to message-weighted networks, and counterfactual exercises show that policies reducing the volume of messages exchanged with peers improve mental health, increasingly so with the size of the reduction, though the effect of targeted reductions depends on which ties are attenuated. Ignoring endogenous peer selection can thus yield qualitatively misleading conclusions about peer effects on mental health.
abstract_zh: 我们考察了内生形成的同伴网络中的社会比较如何影响年轻成人心理健康的多种衡量指标。利用NetHealth研究中超过两百万条基于智能手机的通信记录，我们构建了大学生之间的客观社交网络，并估计了一个结构模型，在该模型中，个体选择其同伴，而心理健康则取决于所选同伴的收入水平。当网络被视为外生时，较高的平均同伴收入预示着更好的心理健康；一旦网络形成被建模为内生过程，这一关系便发生逆转：接触高收入同伴显著加剧了抑郁症状。收入差距在两个方向上都损害心理健康，这与不平等厌恶而非相对剥夺的假设相一致。这一逆转在将二元联系扩展至消息加权网络后依然成立，且反事实实验表明，减少与同伴交换消息量的政策能改善心理健康，且改善程度随减少幅度增大而增强，尽管定向减少的效果取决于被削弱的具体联系。因此，忽视内生的同伴选择可能会对同伴效应影响心理健康得出性质上误导性的结论。

title: Putting the 'Finance' into 'Public Finance': A Theory of Capital Gains Taxation
title_zh: 将“财政”融入“公共财政”：资本利得税理论
title_primary: 将“财政”融入“公共财政”：资本利得税理论
title_secondary: Putting the 'Finance' into 'Public Finance': A Theory of Capital Gains Taxation
authors: Mark Aguiar, Benjamin Moll, Florian Scheuer
official: 官方在线 2026-02-13 · 来源：出版社网页
abstract: Standard optimal capital tax theory abstracts from modeling asset prices, making it unsuitable for thinking about capital gains and wealth taxation. We study optimal redistributive taxation in an environment with asset price movements, adopting the modern finance view that asset prices fluctuate not only because of changing cash flows, but also due to other factors ("discount rates''). We show that a combination of realization-based capital gains and cash flow taxes implements the optimal allocation regardless of the source of asset-price fluctuations. Moreover, the capital gains tax avoids distortions in portfolio choice (the so-called lock-in effect) by targeting total net trades rather than gains from selling individual assets. These results stand in contrast to the classic Haig-Simons comprehensive income tax concept as well as recent proposals for wealth or accrual-based capital gains taxes.
abstract_zh: 标准最优资本税理论在建模时抽象掉了资产价格，因此不适用于思考资本利得和财富税问题。我们在资产价格波动的环境中研究最优再分配税收，采纳现代金融学的观点，即资产价格不仅因现金流变化而波动，还受其他因素（“贴现率”）影响。我们证明，基于实现的资本利得税与现金流税的组合，无论资产价格波动的来源如何，都能实现最优配置。此外，资本利得税通过针对总净交易而非出售个别资产的收益，避免了投资组合选择中的扭曲（即所谓的“锁定效应”）。这些结果与经典的Haig-Simons综合所得税概念以及近期提出的财富税或基于应计制的资本利得税建议形成鲜明对比。

title: Unravelling the Effects of Indonesia's Oil Palm Export Ban on Global Stock Markets
title_zh: 印尼棕榈油出口禁令对全球股市影响的解析
title_primary: 印尼棕榈油出口禁令对全球股市影响的解析
title_secondary: Unravelling the Effects of Indonesia's Oil Palm Export Ban on Global Stock Markets
authors: Tim Ölkers, Charlotte‐Elena Reich, Anna Roeland, Oliver Mußhoff
source: Australian Journal of Agricultural and Resource Economics
official: 官方在线 2026-09-03 · 来源：RSS
abstract: Export bans are frequently used as trade policy instruments to stabilise domestic prices, but they often generate unintended consequences. This study examines the effects of Indonesia's palm oil export ban, introduced in April 2022 and lifted in May 2022, on the performance of the global agricultural sector and the stock markets of palm oil–producing countries. Drawing on a conceptual framework, we develop hypotheses regarding how stock indices with different industrial compositions respond to such trade policy interventions. Using an event study methodology, we analyse daily stock market data from palm oil–producing countries as well as a global agriculture‐specific MSCI index. The analysis encompasses both nationally diversified stock indices and a global sector–specific index. The results reveal statistically significant negative cumulative abnormal returns for the global agricultural index following the introduction of the export ban, whereas national cross‐industry indices show statistically insignificant reactions. Following the lifting of the ban, the global agricultural index experienced statistically significant positive cumulative abnormal returns, whereas national indices exhibited mixed and statistically insignificant responses. These findings are consistent with the conceptual framework, suggesting that the policy primarily affected the global agricultural sector while leaving diversified national stock markets largely unaffected. Importantly, the effects associated with the introduction and subsequent lifting of the ban did not fully offset each other, resulting in an overall negative net effect on the global agricultural index.
abstract_zh: 出口禁令常被用作稳定国内价格的贸易政策工具，但往往会产生意想不到的后果。本研究考察了印度尼西亚于2022年4月实施、2022年5月取消的棕榈油出口禁令对全球农业部门表现及棕榈油生产国股票市场的影响。基于一个概念框架，我们提出了关于不同行业构成的股票指数如何应对此类贸易政策干预的假设。采用事件研究法，我们分析了来自棕榈油生产国的每日股市数据以及一个全球农业特定MSCI指数。分析涵盖了国家层面多元化的股票指数和一个全球行业特定指数。结果显示，出口禁令实施后，全球农业指数出现了统计上显著的负向累积异常收益，而国家跨行业指数则表现出统计上不显著的反应。禁令取消后，全球农业指数经历了统计上显著的正向累积异常收益，而国家指数则表现出混合且统计上不显著的响应。这些发现与概念框架一致，表明该政策主要影响了全球农业部门，而对多元化的国内股票市场影响甚微。重要的是，禁令实施及随后取消所关联的效应并未完全相互抵消，导致全球农业指数整体呈现负的净效应。

title: Does directors’ & officers’ liability insurance impact on internal wage disparity?
title_zh: 董事及高级职员责任保险是否影响内部薪酬差距？
title_primary: 董事及高级职员责任保险是否影响内部薪酬差距？
title_secondary: Does directors’ & officers’ liability insurance impact on internal wage disparity?
authors: Pengju Zheng, Bona Xiao, Zihao Ning
official: Crossref 元数据日期 2026-09-01 · 来源：Crossref
abstract: Providing decent jobs, eradicating poverty and reducing inequality fall under the 17 Sustainable Development Goals of the United Nations. We investigate the impact of Directors’ and Officers’ liability insurance (D&O liability insurance) on internal wage disparity among Chinese listed firms from 2007 to 2022. Our findings reveal that D&O liability insurance is positively correlated with the wage disparity between executives and ordinary employees. This association remains significant after the robustness and endogeneity tests. Furthermore, executive quality, agency issues, subsidy-bolstered performance, reduced scrutiny, and constraint and compensation committees appear to be plausible underlying mechanisms. Finally, our results indicate that the positive association between D&O liability insurance and internal wage disparity is more pronounced in non-state-owned enterprises, firms facing higher market competition, and labour-intensive enterprises. This study sheds new light on the real effects of D&O liability insurance.
abstract_zh: 提供体面工作、消除贫困和减少不平等属于联合国17项可持续发展目标之列。我们考察了2007年至2022年间中国上市公司董事及高级职员责任保险（D&O责任保险）对内部薪酬差距的影响。研究发现，D&O责任保险与高管与普通员工之间的薪酬差距呈正相关。在稳健性和内生性检验后，这一关联依然显著。此外，高管素质、代理问题、补贴支撑的业绩、监督减弱以及约束与薪酬委员会似乎是合理的潜在作用机制。最后，我们的结果表明，D&O责任保险与内部薪酬差距之间的正相关关系在非国有企业、面临更高市场竞争的企业以及劳动密集型企业中更为显著。本研究为D&O责任保险的实际效应提供了新的见解。

title: Rate Risk and Rate Insurance
title_zh: 利率风险与利率保险
title_primary: 利率风险与利率保险
title_secondary: Rate Risk and Rate Insurance
authors: Olivier Wang
official: 官方在线 2026-08-24 · 来源：出版社网页
abstract: I decompose stock returns into a duration-matched Treasury component, identified from monetary policy surprises, and a payoff component. Risk and returns rise much less with duration for stocks than for their matched Treasuries. Stock volatility is dampened by rate insurance: rates fall in bad times, so the bond inside a stock provides insurance against the stock’s payoff risk. Expected stock returns are dampened because the insurance works in reverse: rates rise in good times, so stocks’ payoff gains hedge the losses borne by investors holding net duration, notably government bonds when Ricardian equivalence fails. This framework helps reconcile positive bond premia with negative stock-bond covariance, sheds light on equity anomalies and the collapse of the value premium, implies that fiscal and monetary policy shape bond and equity premia, and motivates a two-factor model that jointly prices stocks and bonds. Rate insurance can even turn the price of long-run risk negative, explaining why long bonds beat long stocks.
abstract_zh: 我将股票收益分解为期限匹配的国债成分（通过货币政策冲击识别）与支付成分。股票的风险和收益随期限上升的幅度远低于其匹配国债。股票波动性受到利率保险的抑制：利率在经济低迷时下降，因此股票内部的债券成分对股票的支付风险提供了保险。预期股票收益受到抑制，因为保险机制反向运作：利率在经济繁荣时上升，因此股票的支付收益对冲了投资者持有净期限敞口（尤其是当李嘉图等价失效时政府债券）所承受的损失。这一框架有助于调和正债券溢价与负股票-债券协方差，揭示股票异象及价值溢价的崩溃，表明财政与货币政策塑造债券和股票溢价，并推动了一个联合定价股票和债券的双因子模型。利率保险甚至能使长期风险的价格转为负值，从而解释长期债券跑赢长期股票的现象。

title: The Polarization Paradox: Why More Connections Can Divide Us
title_zh: 极化悖论：为何更多联系反而使我们分裂
title_primary: 极化悖论：为何更多联系反而使我们分裂
title_secondary: The Polarization Paradox: Why More Connections Can Divide Us
authors: Arthur Campbell, Matthew Leister, Philip Ushchev, Yves Zenou, William Parker 等
official: 官方在线 2025-10-11 · 来源：文章页面
abstract: We develop a simple model of content filtering-the tendency of individuals to selectively forward information that aligns with their ideological preference-to study how network structure shapes the distribution of political content. In our framework, individuals and content are horizontally differentiated into three types (left, middle, right). We show that content filtering can amplify the middle or the extremes and may result in only centrist content (full moderation) or only extreme content (full polarization). The outcome depends on the interaction between two forces: a preference advantage from the relative prevalence of types in the population, and a pairwise comparison advantage that systematically favors centrist content. Network density plays a critical role. Sparse networks robustly yield moderation, even when extreme types dominate the population, while dense networks replicate the population's type distribution. Intermediate densities generate non-monotonic comparative statics, including sharp transitions between moderation and polarization. These findings complement existing empirical results that emphasize the types of connections individuals have on social media by highlighting how the number of connections, holding their composition fixed, may fundamentally shape the information environment in ways that foster/mitigate populism and polarization.
abstract_zh: 我们构建了一个关于内容过滤的简洁模型——即个体倾向于选择性地转发与其意识形态偏好相符的信息——以研究网络结构如何塑造政治内容的分布。在我们的框架中，个体与内容在水平维度上被划分为三种类型（左、中、右）。我们证明，内容过滤可能放大中间派或极端派，并可能导致仅剩中间派内容（完全温和化）或仅剩极端内容（完全极化）。这一结果取决于两种力量的相互作用：一是人口中类型相对普遍性带来的偏好优势，二是系统性地偏向中间派内容的成对比较优势。网络密度起着关键作用。稀疏网络稳健地产生温和化结果，即使极端派在人口中占主导地位也是如此，而密集网络则复制人口的类型分布。中等密度产生非单调的比较静态分析结果，包括温和化与极化之间的急剧转变。这些发现补充了现有强调社交媒体上个体连接类型的实证结果，通过突出连接数量（在保持其构成不变的情况下）如何可能从根本上塑造信息环境，从而促进或缓解民粹主义与极化。

authors: Petr Sedláček, Vincent Sterk
official: 官方在线 2018-07-24 · 来源：文章页面
abstract: we investigate the long-run eﬀects of such tax reforms on ﬁrm dynamics. We ﬁnd that they can substantially increase business dynamism, potentially oﬀsetting the large decline in the U.S. startup rate observed over recent decades. This result is driven by indirect equilibrium forces: the tax reform stimulates ﬁrm entry, leading to an increase in labor demand and wages, which in turn makes ﬁrm selection more stringent. Related to this is a large boost of the number of ﬁrms and of aggregate output, investment and employment.
abstract_zh: 我们研究了此类税制改革对企业动态的长期影响。研究发现，这些改革能显著提升商业活力，可能抵消近几十年来美国创业率的大幅下滑。这一结果由间接均衡力量驱动：税制改革刺激企业进入，导致劳动力需求和工资上升，进而使企业筛选更为严格。与此相关的是，企业数量、总产出、投资和就业均大幅增长。

source: Journal of Economic Behavior and Organization
official: 来源期次 2026-08-01 · 来源：RSS
abstract: This study experimentally investigates the impact of the lack of arbitrage opportunities across different assets on the realization of the law of one price. Our experiment is based on the framework established by Charness and Neugebauer (2019) where participants, acting as traders, are involved in transactions with two different types of assets. We observe an increase in the magnitude of price discrepancies and fundamental mispricing when traders are unable to engage in arbitrage across assets.
abstract_zh: 本研究通过实验方法探讨了不同资产间套利机会缺失对一价法则实现的影响。实验基于Charness和Neugebauer（2019）建立的框架，参与者作为交易者，涉及两种不同类型资产的交易。我们发现，当交易者无法跨资产进行套利时，价格差异的幅度和基本面错误定价均有所增加。

title: Unemployment and Wages of Ethnic Germans
title_zh: 族裔德国人的失业与工资
title_primary: 族裔德国人的失业与工资
title_secondary: Unemployment and Wages of Ethnic Germans
authors: Klaus F. Zimmermann, Thomas Bauer, Dennis Snower, Mike Orszag, Alexia Delfino 等
official: 官方在线 1996-12-20 · 来源：文章页面
abstract: This paper uses the immigration sample of the German Socioeconomic Panel to analyse the earnings and unemployment assimilation of ethnic Germans who entered West Germany within the last ten years. The empirical analysis suggests that there is no earnings differential between immigrants from Eastern Europe and comparable East Germans at the time of immigration. With longer time of residence the earnings of former East Europeans rise faster than those of East Germans, however. Migrants from Poland and the former USSR have higher unemployment risks than those from East Germany or Romania. Ethnic networks are shown to be very useful for a successful integration into the labour market.
abstract_zh: 本文利用德国社会经济面板数据中的移民样本，分析了过去十年内进入西德的德裔移民的收入与失业同化情况。实证分析表明，在移民初期，东欧移民与可比的东德人之间不存在收入差异。然而，随着居住时间延长，前东欧移民的收入增长速度快于东德人。来自波兰和前苏联的移民面临比东德或罗马尼亚移民更高的失业风险。研究表明，族群网络对成功融入劳动力市场具有重要作用。

title: Employing the Unemployed of Marienthal: Evaluation of a Guaranteed Job Program
title_zh: 利用马里恩塔尔的失业者：一项保障就业计划的评估
title_primary: 利用马里恩塔尔的失业者：一项保障就业计划的评估
title_secondary: Employing the Unemployed of Marienthal: Evaluation of a Guaranteed Job Program
authors: Kasy, Maximilian, Lehner, Lukas
official: 来源期次 American Economic Journal: Economic Policy · 来源：期刊官网
abstract: We evaluate a guaranteed job program in Austria in 2020–2024. Our evaluation is based on three approaches, pairwise matched randomization, a pre-registered synthetic control at the municipality level, and a comparison to individuals in control municipalities. This allows us to estimate direct effects, anticipation effects, and spillover effects. We find positive impacts on economic and non-economic wellbeing. At the municipality level, we find a reduction of long-term unemployment and no negative employment spillovers. There are positive anticipation effects on well-being, status, and social inclusion. We estimate program costs of 237 Euro per participant and month. Participant income increased by 102 Euro.
abstract_zh: 我们评估了奥地利2020-2024年的一项保障就业项目。该评估基于三种方法：配对匹配随机化、预先注册的市级合成控制法，以及与对照市镇个体的比较。这使我们能够估计直接效应、预期效应和溢出效应。研究发现，该项目对经济和非经济福祉均产生了积极影响。在市级层面，长期失业率有所下降，且未发现负面的就业溢出效应。预期效应对福祉、社会地位和社会融入产生了积极影响。我们估算的项目成本为每位参与者每月237欧元，参与者收入增加了102欧元。

title: Social mobility, Protests, and Migration: Evidence from Latin American Countries.
title_zh: 社会流动、抗议与移民：来自拉丁美洲国家的证据
title_primary: 社会流动、抗议与移民：来自拉丁美洲国家的证据
title_secondary: Social mobility, Protests, and Migration: Evidence from Latin American Countries.
authors: Maria Marino, Xavier Ramos, Riccardo Turati
official: 官方在线月份 2026-07 · 来源：文章页面
abstract: This paper investigates the relationship between intergenerational social mobility, migration aspirations, and participation in political demonstrations. Using individual-level data from the Latinobarómetro between 2002 and 2023, we show that individuals experiencing negative intergenerational educational mobility are more likely to express a desire to migrate and to participate into peaceful protests, whereas those with positive mobility exhibit the opposite pattern. Our analysis further suggests that the decision to migrate and to protest may be shaped by a common underlying decision process. Finally, we find that confidence in political institutions and positive economic expectations substantially mitigate expressions of social discontent in the form of migration aspirations and protest participation. Overall, the results indicate that unequal opportunities across generations are an important determinant of both migration intentions and political engagement.
abstract_zh: 本文研究了代际社会流动、移民意愿与政治示威参与之间的关系。利用2002年至2023年间拉丁美洲晴雨表的个体层面数据，我们发现，经历负向代际教育流动的个体更可能表达移民意愿并参与和平抗议，而经历正向代际教育流动的个体则呈现相反模式。进一步分析表明，移民与抗议决策可能受共同潜在决策过程的影响。最后，研究发现对政治体制的信心与积极的经济预期能够显著缓解以移民意愿和抗议参与形式表现的社会不满情绪。总体而言，研究结果表明代际机会不平等是移民意向与政治参与的重要决定因素。

title: What’s in a name? Dynasties, selection, and talent allocation among classical composers
title_zh: 名字里有什么？古典作曲家中的家族传承、选拔与人才配置
title_primary: 名字里有什么？古典作曲家中的家族传承、选拔与人才配置
title_secondary: What’s in a name? Dynasties, selection, and talent allocation among classical composers
authors: Karol Jan Borowiecki, Martin Hørlyk Kristensen, Marc T. Law
official: 官方在线 2026-07-06 · 来源：RSS
abstract: A central question in economics is how talent is allocated across elite professions and whether access is shaped by family ties or by open, standardized systems of selection. We study these questions in Western classical composition, a setting in which family background historically influenced entry through both inherited skill and inherited privilege, and where rich biographical records make it possible to trace selection over multiple centuries. Using data on more than 16,000 composers from 450 CE to the present, we identify dynastic ties from Grove Music Online and measure prominence by biographical entry length. Dynastic composers are 15–21 percent less prominent than non-dynasts, conditional on country and birth cohort, and this discount is driven by descendants: founders perform about as well as non-dynasts, while descendants perform significantly worse. Archival manuscript evidence from the Répertoire International des Sources Musicales yields similar results, suggesting that the pattern is not an artifact of editorial selection. In the twentieth century, however, the dynasty discount reverses, consistent with the transition from informal, family-based entry to more standardized selection through conservatory training. Consistent with this interpretation, dynasts are less likely to have formal training mentioned in their biographies, more likely to be described as advancing through family connections, and face a smaller dynasty discount in regions and periods with conservatories. Taken together, the findings suggest that expanded access to standardized training can weaken inherited advantage, reshape elite formation, and improve talent allocation, with broader implications for long-run innovation and economic performance.
abstract_zh: 经济学的一个核心问题是，人才如何在精英职业中分配，以及进入这些职业的途径是由家庭关系塑造，还是由开放、标准化的选拔体系决定。我们以西方古典作曲为背景研究这些问题，在这一领域中，家庭背景历史上通过继承技能和继承特权影响进入，而丰富的传记记录使我们能够追溯多个世纪的选拔过程。利用公元450年至今超过16,000名作曲家的数据，我们从《格罗夫音乐在线》中识别出家族纽带，并通过传记条目长度衡量知名度。在控制国家和出生队列的条件下，家族作曲家的知名度比非家族作曲家低15%至21%，这一折扣主要由后代驱动：创始人的表现与非家族作曲家相当，而后代的表现则显著较差。来自《国际音乐源目录》的档案手稿证据得出了类似结果，表明这一模式并非编辑选择的产物。然而，在20世纪，家族折扣发生了逆转，这与从非正式、基于家庭的进入向通过音乐学院培训进行标准化选拔的转变相一致。与这一解释一致的是，家族作曲家在其传记中提及正式培训的可能性较低，更可能被描述为通过家庭关系晋升，并且在有音乐学院的地区和时期，家族折扣较小。综合来看，这些发现表明，扩大标准化培训的获取渠道可以削弱继承优势，重塑精英形成，并改善人才分配，对长期创新和经济表现具有更广泛的意义。

title: Agricultural workers’ employment cycles and churn in the Supplemental Nutrition Assistance Program: A descriptive analysis
title_zh: 农业工人就业周期与补充营养援助计划中的流失：一项描述性分析
title_primary: 农业工人就业周期与补充营养援助计划中的流失：一项描述性分析
title_secondary: Agricultural workers’ employment cycles and churn in the Supplemental Nutrition Assistance Program: A descriptive analysis
authors: Casey J. McNichols, C. Ambrozek, Timothy K. M. Beatty
official: Crossref 元数据日期 2026-07-06 · 来源：Crossref
abstract: The Supplemental Nutrition Assistance Program (SNAP) is a safety net for 41 million low-income people in the United States. Although 80% of all eligible individuals participate, SNAP eligible agricultural workers likely participate in SNAP at about half that rate. Agricultural workers may be less attached to the safety net because seasonal employment makes administrative burdens more salient and can induce variation in eligibility. In this paper we examine how seasonality affects farmworker attachment to SNAP. We measure households’ attachment to SNAP with churn rates. Churn occurs when a household exits SNAP and subsequently re-enters the program within 3 months. With household-level administrative data from Fresno County as a case study, we provide descriptive evidence that farmworkers are more likely to churn than other SNAP participants. SNAP churn among farmworkers increases significantly when agricultural employment falls after seasonal peaks, particularly for crop production and support activities. We estimate a seasonal pattern in churn for farmworkers that does not exist for non-farmworkers, indicating that the patterns we observe cannot be explained by baseline seasonality alone. Understanding the relationship between churn and the seasonality of agricultural employment has the potential to improve access to the safety net for a vulnerable population, as well as reduce SNAP related costs for both households and the state.
abstract_zh: 补充营养援助计划（SNAP）是美国4100万低收入人群的安全网。尽管所有符合条件的个体中有80%参与其中，但符合SNAP资格的农业工人参与率可能仅为该比例的一半左右。农业工人可能因季节性就业而更少依赖安全网，因为季节性工作使行政负担更为突出，并可能导致资格条件的变化。本文考察了季节性如何影响农场工人对SNAP的依附程度。我们通过流失率来衡量家庭对SNAP的依附情况。流失是指家庭退出SNAP后在3个月内重新加入该计划的现象。以弗雷斯诺县的家庭层面行政数据为案例研究，我们提供了描述性证据，表明农场工人比其他SNAP参与者更易发生流失。当农业就业在季节性高峰后下降时，农场工人的SNAP流失率显著增加，尤其是在作物生产及支持活动领域。我们估计出农场工人流失的季节性模式，而非农场工人则不存在此模式，这表明我们观察到的模式不能仅由基线季节性来解释。理解流失与农业就业季节性之间的关系，有望改善这一弱势群体获取安全网的途径，同时降低家庭和州政府与SNAP相关的成本。

title: Lack of Trust and Fiscal Dominance: Evidence from a Firm Survey Experiment
title_zh: 信任缺失与财政主导：来自企业调查实验的证据
title_primary: 信任缺失与财政主导：来自企业调查实验的证据
title_secondary: Lack of Trust and Fiscal Dominance: Evidence from a Firm Survey Experiment
authors: Francesco Bianchi, Renato Faccini, Leonardo Melosi, Nils Wehrhöfer
official: 官方在线 2026-06-15 · 来源：出版社网页
abstract: We study how debt news shapes firms’ inflation expectations in a monetary union. In an active-control experiment, German firms receive optimistic or pessimistic projections of France, Italy, and Spain’s debt-to-GDP ratios. Pessimistic news raises debt beliefs and increases one- and three-year inflation expectations, with no detectable effect at five years. The response is driven by low-trust firms and by firms expecting relatively low ECB policy rates. A salient German debt-financed fiscal shock generates no comparable response. Within a Fisherian framework, the evidence suggests that debt news becomes inflationary when firms perceive incomplete fiscal backing and expect monetary accommodation.
abstract_zh: 我们研究了在货币联盟中，债务新闻如何影响企业的通胀预期。在一项主动控制实验中，德国企业收到了关于法国、意大利和西班牙债务与GDP比率的乐观或悲观预测。悲观新闻提高了债务信念，并增加了一年期和三年期的通胀预期，但对五年期通胀预期没有显著影响。这种反应主要由低信任度企业以及预期欧洲央行政策利率相对较低的企业驱动。一个显著的德国债务融资财政冲击并未产生类似反应。在费雪框架内，证据表明，当企业认为财政支持不充分并预期货币政策宽松时，债务新闻会引发通胀效应。

authors: Yong-Chan Choi, Kyungmoo Heo
official: 官方在线 2026-06-15 · 来源：文章页面
abstract: 미·중 간 기술 패권 경쟁이 지속되면서 미국 등 주요국은 핵심 과학기술 분야에서 자국 기술과 산업을 보호·육성하기 위한 전략을 강화하고 있다. 각국 정부는 연구개발 투자를 확대하는 동시에 기술 보호 및 육성을 위한 법·제도적 기반을 정비하고 있으며, 기술 경쟁력 확보뿐만 아니라 국가 안보와 산업 생태계 강화를 목표로 하고 있다. 주요 선진국들은 핵심 기술 분야의 발전을 지원하면서 불필요한 규제를 완화하고, 기술 보호를 위한 새로운 규제를 도입하는 등 정교한 정책 설계를 시도하고 있다. 이러한 규제 혁신 전략을 분석함으로써 선진국의 과학기술 발전 전략과 혁신 생태계 조성 방식, 산업 발전을 위한 정책적 접근법을 비교·분석할 필요가 있다. 본 연구에서는 기존 연구에서 다루지 않았던 과학기술 분야별 규제 혁신 전략들에 대한 다면적 분석을 통해 빠른 속도로 변하고 있는 과학기술 분야 미래 규제 환경에 대한 우리의 효과적 대응 전략을 제시한다. As the competition for technological hegemony intensifies between the U.S. and China, major advanced countries around the world, including the U.S., are increasingly strengthening their strategies to protect and foster their technologies and industries in core science and technology fields. The governments of individual countries are expanding R&D investment, reorganizing legal and institutional foundations for technology protection and fostering, and aiming to strengthen national security and industrial ecosystems as well as securing technological competitiveness.
abstract_zh: 随着美中之间技术霸权竞争的持续，美国等主要国家正加强在核心科学技术领域保护和培育本国技术与产业的战略。各国政府在扩大研发投资的同时，也在完善技术保护与培育的法律制度基础，其目标不仅在于确保技术竞争力，还在于强化国家安全与产业生态系统。主要发达国家在支持核心技术领域发展的同时，正尝试通过放宽不必要的监管、引入新的技术保护监管等精细化的政策设计。通过分析这些监管创新战略，有必要对发达国家的科技发展战略、创新生态构建方式以及促进产业发展的政策路径进行比较分析。本研究通过对现有研究尚未涉及的科技领域监管创新战略进行多维度分析，为快速变化的科技领域未来监管环境提出有效的应对策略。

title: Why Have CEO Pay Levels Become Less Diverse?
title_zh: 为何CEO薪酬水平变得不那么多样化？
title_primary: 为何CEO薪酬水平变得不那么多样化？
title_secondary: Why Have CEO Pay Levels Become Less Diverse?
authors: TORSTEN JOCHEM, GAIZKA ORMAZABAL, ANJANA RAJAMANI
official: 官方在线 2026-05-19 · 来源：RSS
abstract: This paper documents a new stylized fact: the cross‐sectional variation in CEO pay levels has declined precipitously in recent years. We offer one explanation for this decline, namely, firms are increasingly benchmarking CEO compensation to industry peers closest in size, thereby creating pay clusters. Our empirical tests provide support for this explanation and suggest that the rise of industry‐size benchmarking is driven by three institutional factors: the mandatory disclosure of compensation peer groups, proxy advisory influence, and say‐on‐pay regulation. Our findings highlight a consequence of adopting a one‐size‐fits‐all standard in the pay‐setting process.
abstract_zh: 本文揭示了一个新的典型事实：近年来，CEO薪酬水平的截面差异急剧缩小。我们对此现象提出一种解释：企业日益倾向于以行业内规模最接近的同行作为薪酬基准，从而形成薪酬聚类。实证检验支持这一解释，并表明行业规模基准化的兴起由三项制度因素驱动：薪酬对标群体的强制披露、代理投票顾问的影响力以及薪酬话语权监管。研究结果凸显了在薪酬制定过程中采用"一刀切"标准所带来的后果。

title: Raising the bar: An inclusive global poverty line
title_zh: 提高标准：一个包容性的全球贫困线
title_primary: 提高标准：一个包容性的全球贫困线
title_secondary: Raising the bar: An inclusive global poverty line
authors: Lant Pritchett, Martina Viarengo
official: Crossref 元数据日期 2026-04-30 · 来源：Crossref
abstract: The first of the United Nations 2015 Sustainable Development Goals is: “End poverty in all its forms everywhere.” An implication of this broad goal is the existence of an array of poverty lines, which raises the question of an appropriate lower-bound and an upper-bound to global poverty lines. The ‘dollar-a-day’ poverty line (updated for inflation to P$2.15 in 2017 PPP) is widely accepted as a global lower-bound poverty line (GLBPL). However, while different countries, organizations, and authors use higher poverty lines, there is no consensus on a global upper bound poverty line (GUBPL). We estimate a GUBPL using two conceptually distinct approaches, both grounded in the tension between the focus axiom for poverty measures and standard economic social welfare measures. We set a candidate GUBPL either at: (i) the consumption consistent with the achievement of adequate material well-being or (ii) the consumption level where marginal utility is “near enough” zero. Using either approach, empirical results across an array of measures of well-being demonstrate that ad hoc poverty lines, including the World Bank's highest reported poverty line of P$6.85, are far too low to be plausible candidates for a GUBPL. Using the two approaches across four distinct indicators of well-being all of the empirical results suggest a GUBPL of at least P$21.5, ten times higher than the standard GLPBL of P$2.15. The use of both a lower bound and upper bound global poverty line balances the radically exclusive nature of the ‘dollar-a-day’ standard, which classifies people with very low levels of material well-being and hence very high marginal utility of income as “not poor” with an equally radically inclusive GUBPL which counts only those with globally high material achievement and low (ish) marginal utility of income as “not poor.”
abstract_zh: 联合国2015年可持续发展目标之首为：“在世界各地消除一切形式的贫困。”这一广泛目标隐含着一系列贫困线的存在，从而引出了全球贫困线适当下限与上限的问题。“每日一美元”贫困线（按2017年购买力平价调整后为P$2.15）被广泛接受为全球贫困线下限（GLPBL）。然而，尽管不同国家、组织及作者采用更高的贫困线，但对于全球贫困线上限（GUBPL）尚无共识。我们采用两种概念上截然不同的方法估算GUBPL，这两种方法均基于贫困测度中的焦点公理与标准经济社会福利度量之间的张力。我们设定候选GUBPL为：（i）与实现充分物质福祉相一致的消费水平，或（ii）边际效用“接近”零的消费水平。采用任一方法，跨多种福祉指标的实证结果表明，临时设定的贫困线，包括世界银行报告的最高贫困线P$6.85，远低于作为GUBPL合理候选的水平。运用这两种方法及四项不同的福祉指标，所有实证结果均表明GUBPL至少为P$21.5，是标准GLPBL（P$2.15）的十倍。同时采用全球贫困线下限与上限，平衡了“每日一美元”标准的极端排他性——该标准将物质福祉极低、因而收入边际效用极高的人群归类为“非贫困”——与同样极端包容性的GUBPL——该上限仅将全球物质成就高且收入边际效用较低（或偏低）的人群视为“非贫困”。

title: Number one girl: Female top scorers and peer academic performance in junior high schools
title_zh: 第一名女孩：初中女学霸与同伴学业表现
title_primary: 第一名女孩：初中女学霸与同伴学业表现
title_secondary: Number one girl: Female top scorers and peer academic performance in junior high schools
authors: Xuezheng Qin, Yingfei Wang, Haochen Zhang
official: Crossref 元数据日期 2026-04-13 · 来源：Crossref
abstract: In a tournament-style education system, the high salience of ordinal academic rankings may amplify top performers’ influence as role models. This paper investigates how the gender of the top scorer in the class affects peer students’ outcomes in Chinese junior high schools. Leveraging a regression discontinuity design that exploits minimal score differences between the top-performing female and male students in a class, we find that having a female first-ranked student in a major exam significantly improves subsequent academic performance among girls, while no comparable effects are observed among boys. This gender-specific effect potentially operates through multiple channels: when a female student ranks first in the class, other girls exhibit higher levels of self-confidence, academic aspirations, study effort, and receive more parental support—effects that are not present among boys. Furthermore, the impact of top performer gender is particularly pronounced among academically lower-ranked girls and those from disadvantaged families. In sum, this paper provides the first causal evidence of the gender-differentiated external effect of ordinal ranks in educational settings.
abstract_zh: 在锦标赛式教育体系中，序数排名的显著突出性可能放大顶尖学生作为榜样的影响力。本文探讨了班级中最高分者的性别如何影响中国初中同伴学生的学业成果。利用回归不连续设计，借助班级内表现最优的女生与男生之间微小的分数差异，我们发现，在重要考试中，若女生排名第一，则能显著提升其他女生的后续学业表现，而男生则未观察到类似效应。这种性别特定效应可能通过多种渠道发挥作用：当女生在班级中排名第一时，其他女生展现出更高的自信心、学业抱负、学习努力程度，并获得更多家长支持——这些效应在男生中并不显现。此外，顶尖学生性别的影响在学业排名较低及家庭背景不利的女生中尤为显著。总之，本文首次提供了教育环境中序数排名性别差异化外部效应的因果证据。

title: Seizing central bank assets?
title_zh: 没收央行资产？
title_primary: 没收央行资产？
title_secondary: Seizing central bank assets?
authors: Massimo Ferrari Minesso, Tobias Krahnke, Arnaud Mehl, Isabel Vansteenkiste
official: 官方在线 2025-12-26 · 来源：RSS
abstract: We study the global impacts of sanctions on central bank assets. We build a database on freezes and seizures of central bank assets spanning 1914–2024. We show that the scale of the freeze on today’s Central Bank of Russia’s assets is rarely seen in history and that non-belligerent countries have never seized central bank assets to finance reconstruction in a third country in an ongoing war. We propose a three-country DSGE model to understand the global impacts of sanctions on central bank assets and tease out the macroeconomic mechanisms. One insight of the model is that seizing central bank assets can result in adverse effects on the sanctioning country in general equilibrium. Calibrated model simulations suggest that seizing Russia’s immobilized sovereign assets could result in higher interest rates on sanctioning countries’ government bonds. The increase in interest rate payments could surpass the assets’ amount seized after about three years.
abstract_zh: 我们研究了制裁对中央银行资产的全球影响。我们构建了一个覆盖1914年至2024年中央银行资产冻结与没收事件的数据库。研究表明，当今俄罗斯中央银行资产被冻结的规模在历史上极为罕见，且非交战国从未在持续冲突中没收中央银行资产以资助第三国的重建。我们提出了一个三国DSGE模型，以理解制裁对中央银行资产的全球影响，并揭示宏观经济机制。模型的一个洞见是，没收中央银行资产在一般均衡中可能对制裁国产生不利影响。校准模型模拟显示，没收俄罗斯被冻结的主权资产可能导致制裁国政府债券利率上升。约三年后，增加的利息支付可能超过被没收资产的金额。

title: Bridging green expertise: the role of directors’ green capital in corporate green innovation resilience
title_zh: 弥合绿色专长：董事绿色资本在企业绿色创新韧性中的作用
title_primary: 弥合绿色专长：董事绿色资本在企业绿色创新韧性中的作用
title_secondary: Bridging green expertise: the role of directors’ green capital in corporate green innovation resilience
authors: Junchao Li, Mengjie Zhao, Jing Ren
official: 官方在线 2025-09-29 · 来源：RSS
abstract: This study investigates how interlocking directors with green experience (IDGEs) influence corporate green innovation resilience, based on panel data from 4,400 Chinese A-share listed firms during 2009–2023, estimating the effect using a multivariate fixed effects regression approach. We find that IDGEs significantly increase green innovation resilience (coefficient = 2.372, p < 0.01), mainly by strengthening managerial green awareness and facilitating access to environmental resources. The positive impact of IDGEs is amplified under external compliance pressure but mitigated when firms have mature internal environmental systems. Further analysis reveals that the effect is more pronounced in firms that purchase directors’ and officers’ liability insurance and those that employ executives with environmental backgrounds. These findings underscore the importance of board-level environmental expertise in improving firms’ adaptive capacity in the green transition, particularly under increasingly stringent regulatory and market constraints.
